Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候有一个人叫神农。他需要当上医，一看别的人就想帮助他们。但是，他有一个问题，他不知道什么东西能做药。神农听说一个远远的地方有一种植物，什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好。神农三个月走去，找到有植物的地方，他看到一个很漂亮的植物，又香又好看。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 他需要当上医：医生
- 一看别的人就想帮助他们：看到，看look vs.看到see; 病人，“别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”
- 什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好：吃了以后
- 神农三个月走去：走了三个月

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，The original repeats the idea of “time”: 古代 already names a historical time period, so 的时候 is redundant here. [teacher rule: gudai_de_shihou_why]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 当上医：当上医生，医 is not normally used alone as the name of a profession; 医生 means a doctor. [rule: word_choice]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 看：看到，Here the intended meaning is “see a person,” not “look at a person,” so the resultative complement 到 is needed. [rule: resultative_complement]
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别的人：别人，别人 refers naturally to other people in general; 别的 is used to distinguish another type or one alternative from a stated one. [teacher rule: bieren]
5. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一个远远的地方：一个很远的地方，远远的 is not the usual modifier in this noun phrase; 很远的 directly describes a faraway place. [rule: word_choice]
6. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一个很漂亮的植物：一株很漂亮的植物，株 is the appropriate measure word for an individual plant. [rule: none]
7. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 他有一个问题，他不知道：他有一个问题，不知道，After the subject has appeared in the same sentence and no other person competes as the subject, use zero form rather than repeat the pronoun. [rule: redundancy_delete]
8. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农听说：他听说，The character was named in the preceding sentence and no competing character has appeared, so a pronoun is more natural for this close re-occurrence. [rule: none]
9. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农三个月走去：他三个月走去，The same character was just mentioned, so use a pronoun rather than repeat the name. [rule: none]
10. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 他看到：看到，Within the same sentence, the subject is already clear, so use zero form for the later action. [rule: redundancy_delete]
11. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 三个月走去：走了三个月，For a completed journey lasting a stated period, place the duration after the verb and use 了 to mark the completed action. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
12. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 看到：看到了，This is the final completed action in the sequence, so add 了 after the resultative complement 到. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: 古代已经表示时间，古代的时候按教师规则重复了时间含义。
医不能单独用作这里的职业名称，应说医生。
这里表示“看见病人”，需要用看到而不是看。
原句应说病人；改成别人虽语法正确，却没有改正原本把病人说成“别的人”的问题。
远远的地方可以表示很远的地方，并非错误。
说单独的一株植物时，株是合适的量词。
这两个分句中重复他可以接受，零形式并非在此必须使用。
在此重新说神农很自然，前面已有多个分句，不能算错误。
神农刚在前句出现且没有竞争指称对象，用他较符合近距离重复的指称规则；但改后仍有三个月走去的错误。
他看到作为后一个分句的主语可以保留；而删去后显示的看到还缺少叙事完成所需的了。
表示完成的行走持续时间应说走了三个月，不能说三个月走去。
这是动作序列中最后完成的动作，按教师规则应说看到了。
